summary: Trivial passthrough: an int __fastcall function that ignores its first argument a1 and returns its second argument a2 unchanged. No fields, globals, guards, or callees are referenced; the function touches no state and only forwards a2 to the caller.

operations.description: Return parameter a2 (second argument) directly to the caller, ignoring a1.
Parameter a1 is accepted but never read; the function performs no computation or side effects.

unresolved: Whether this is a genuine forwarding/identity shim or an unfinished placeholder is unknown: the packet lists no callers or callees to confirm how a1 and a2 are used at the call sites.
